asA: shelf consumer selecting a Turnstile widget mode for my project
iWant: to elicit one of managed, non-interactive or invisible at apply time with managed as the recommendedDefault, and to see each mode render as Cloudflare documents
soThat: my applied surface matches the operational profile the site needs (interactive challenge, always non-interactive, or invisible background check)
title: T-5 widget mode elicit: managed, non-interactive and invisible each render per Cloudflare documented widget modes and the elicited default is managed

acceptanceCriteria.description: The blueprint elicit widget-mode contributes an enum with values managed, non-interactive and invisible; recommendedDefault managed. The pack fixture accepts ?mode=<managed|non-interactive|invisible> and mounts the widget with the pinned test sitekeys that match Cloudflare documented mode variants (sitekey 1x0000000000000000000000AA for interactive-pass, 1x0000000000000000000000BB for invisible-pass). Each mode renders the Turnstile iframe from challenges.cloudflare.com and no third-party origin.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture loaded with mode set to managed, non-interactive and invisible respectively
acceptanceCriteria.then: each renders the Turnstile widget from Cloudflare Turnstile origin only and no third-party script is loaded
